subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should `--message-file` preserve readable non-regular sources such as FIFOs and shell process substitution, or become a regular-file-only interface with a separate stdin path?
rationale: The shipped command accepts those sources, this PR silently rejects them, and the overlapping broader PR could provide an explicit stdin migration but carries additional product-policy changes.

options.title: Preserve readable paths
options.body: Use a bounded read that keeps symlinks, FIFOs, and process-substitution inputs working while enforcing the selected byte limit.

options.title: Add stdin then restrict files
options.body: Land an explicit stdin path and document `--message-file` as regular-file-only with clear upgrade guidance.

options.title: Restrict files immediately
options.body: Accept the compatibility break and document the size and regular-file-only contract before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve readable paths
recommendation.body: Use a bounded read that keeps symlinks, FIFOs, and process-substitution inputs working while enforcing the selected byte limit.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current message-file runtime and documentation contract.
